claims.text: German-American theoretical physicist and research professor at the University of Nevada, Reno, publishing in general relativity, Planck-scale physics, nuclear fusion and plasma physics; published related negative-mass propulsion work in the Journal of the British Interplanetary Society (2011).

edges.label: authored by
edges.note: The DIA congressional list credits 'Negative Mass Propulsion' to 'Dr F Winterberg, Univ of Nevada-Reno'. Winterberg is also credited on the same list with 'Advanced Nuclear Propulsion for Manned Deep Space Missions', and published related negative-mass propulsion work in the Journal of the British Interplanetary Society in 2011.
